notes.title: Steel Rats 3rd Anniversary: The Screamer
notes.notes:
From concept to reality. [b]The Screamer[/b] became the definitive foe of Steel Rats!

The bulky beast appeared at events, complete with working screens. A true example of heavy metal

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33040674/9bc19a88e91688786cbc3ae253e24cf2122f2b51.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33040674/43b63e5284f15a888dfe6b767a1b5779add4e91b.jpg[/img]

The Screamer wasn’t always rocking more screens than your average Twitch streamer. At one stage, it featured cages that contained hapless humans. Its body was similar to that of a large engine, complete with thick smoke coughing from large cylinders on its side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33040674/72807131533fbefeae00d04fd379d8170cc27357.jpg[/img]

The process of ideas on paper, to pixels on the screen (or in this case, giant pieces of steel at an expo!) is long and always changing. Think of it like water going into different containers. Sometimes the container is shaped like a human stealing robot, other times it's a multiple TV headed metal beast!


For those curious about how exactly we brought The Screamer to life, check out this video!

[previewyoutube=WZtAVSPnE3g;full][/previewyoutube]



Steel Rats is 50% off until November 8th as part of our third-anniversary celebration.

notes.title: Wreck and ride with the Steel Rats’ 3rd Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33040674/238f7e039f5589c09b190a45804d68bc73b3ae75.png[/img]

3 years ago, the Steel Rats began revving their engines. On November 7th, 2018 rubber was burned, scrap was gathered and junkbots were obliterated. In celebration of Steel Rats’ anniversary, we’re taking some time to reflect. From concept and development to the full release and you’re invited to join us for a ride through the coolest dieselpunk universe in video games.

[previewyoutube=x1-fIU4DI_Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ll be powerslide through the archives to reveal exactly how an alternative 1940’s American Coastal City falls victim to mean machinery programmed to wipe out humanity. Showcasing art, storyboards, a giant promotional junkbot we took to events (no, really), rap tracks and music from Japanese band The 5.6.7.8's (yes from the Kill Bill Part 1), and more.

Put the pedal to the metal and spin those wheels towards our social media to get involved in our Steel Rats 3rd anniversary.

notes.title: Controller Issue - how to fix it?
notes.notes:
Hi guys, 
some of you have encountered a problem with a controller. 

The issue is related to the Steam bug, that might be hard to fix from our side. Since [h1]there is a workaround known to fix the issue[/h1], I suggest sticking to it. 

Mentioned workaround: 
1. Open Steam Library.
2. Find and Right-click on the Steel Rats.
3. Choose the "Properties" as shown on the first screen
4. In GENERAL tab open the drop down list under the "Steam Input Per-Game Setting".
5. Select Forced On as shown on the second screen.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33040674/2cc5f19b287d8ecc17d9865632b8027ac013e669.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33040674/5f6fe75da6071beb048e02d25f0f286c2cddb0f2.jpg[/img]

Sorry for the inconvenience and we hope that from now on you can fully experience gameplay of Steel Rats.

notes.title: Steel Rats - We're working on the Controller Issue
notes.notes:

few of you reached us out with reports about issues with the controller.

But most importantly - we would like to notify you that [h1]we're currently working on the solution [/h1] that will allow you to experience fully Steel Rats' gameplay. 

Sorry for the inconvenience, and I'll let you know about the fix as soon as I can.

Cheers,
TM

notes.title: Steel Rats Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33040674/d099be973b50673e36091e04b9d55f88a5313e01.jpg[/img]

Hiya Bikers, 
As the developer we're keen to hear from you. We gather every bit of feedback, we are getting and we plan to use it to improve our game, based on your feelings.
Update Includes following tweaks and changes: 

[list]
[*] Balanced HP, Energy, Junk and Points amount needed to unlock Abilities 
[*] Motorcycles Max Speed is decreased (however max speed with wheelsaw turned on is the same)
[*] Usage of wheelsaw now consumes Energy
[*] BB ability doesn’t consume Energy anymore
[*]  When attacking with Wheelsaw, Motorcycle will auto-target to the nearest Junkbot
[*] Vertical riding restores Energy (Wheelsaw FX colored blue)
[*]  Motorcycles are heavier, they don’t flip upside down so easily 
[*]  Drone Junkbots attack faster and deal more Damage
[*]  Hitting the walls at high-speed results in a crash and losing HP 
[*] Falling upside down results in a crash and losing HP
[*] Barbed Wire doesn't stop motorcycle anymore
[*] Reminders of Tutorials added (we display some crucial controls instructions for the second time so you don’t have to worry about skipping them)
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

Hope that those changes will maximize your fun with Steel Rats
Let us know in the comments below or on our social media channels what you think!

notes.title: Offbeat biker platformer Steel Rats is out now
notes.notes:
From its towering bodged-together murderous junk-bots to its bizarre saw-wheeled bikes and its alternate dieselpunk 1940s setting, Steel Rats, released today, is an odd beast. An unusual vehicular action game from Tate Multimedia, part shooter, part platformer, part stunt racer. Players control a biker gang, battling robots across a ruined America, free to drive anywhere (including walls and ceilings) ‘cos they’ve got big saw-blades for wheels. I’m still not entirely sure how this works physics-wise, but it’s cool so I’ll give it a pass. Rev up for the launch trailer below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33040674/f9cb6f18cae64238aceb2d5a466c01a0456dfb80.jpg[/img]

Hiya Members of the Rat Pack!

We’re warming up before the launch of Steel Rats™! And we’re doing that with a bang!

Bid now https://www.ebay.com/itm/312285202231  for the biggest (literally) collectors edition of all time and help us raise money for charities!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u_w8cwi8fhU

Do you remember kick-ass 9-foot /3 metre tall, 1700lb/800kg behemoth that has been custom made with over 500 pieces of steel and scrap metal and went with us to the gaming events and expos around the globe?
Some people wanted piece of him as a souvenir. Now guess what? You can own him! Completely (with some cool additional stuff)

We’re proud to present you the…
‘STEEL RATS™: SUPER TURBO ULTIMATE WRECK & RIDE COLLECTORS EDITION’!

List of contents:

[list]
[*] a life-size full metal replica of the Screamer junk robot from Steel Rats™
[*] swath of official merchandise (a special limited edition steel canister, branded whisky glasses, a T-shirt, stickers and pins)
[*] three copies of the game to play on the platform of your choice
[/list]

The four charities officially partnered with the campaign are Special Effect in the UK, Able Gamers in the US, Gaming Aid in Germany and Make a Wish in France. Each of these charities does exceptional work towards helping those living with a disability, harness the power of video games to improve quality of life and find new ways to enjoy their favourite past time.


The auction starts today at €5,000 and is open to buyers in Europe, Japan and Northern America and will last for ten days. For any bids exceeding the opening figure 70% of the final sale price will be committed and split between the four charities.

About release of the game:
Steel Rats™ releases next week November 7th. Price for the game is going to be €19.99 / $19,99 / £15.99 

Add to your wishlist on Steam!

notes.title: Steel Rats ramps into stores on November 7th
notes.notes:
It only feels right to call the bikes in Steel Rats ‘choppers’, considering that their front wheels are also saw-blades, ideal for grinding through robots, letting players climb vertical walls and even adhere to ceilings. Tate Multimedia’s offbeat vehicular platformer is nearly ready to roll out, and launches on November 7th.

I played a bit of Steel Rats earlier this year at Rezzed. While I was only just getting a handle on its controls by the end of my demo run, it felt good. It borrows some bits from the likes of Excite Bike and Trials, but assembles them into something fresh. Below, a developer diary with a bit of game footage – make sure you turn on subtitles if you don’t speak Polish.

notes.title: Look how one of the deadliest enemies of Steel Rats was brought to life!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33040674/86e75ab597070b194e9da2f125af2f703e058515.png[/img]

...It’s too late to run, it’s too late to hide!
The alien invasion we’ve all been dreading has finally landed and it comes in the shape of a [b]10-foot-tall, 1,900-pound[/b] junk robot that can be found at a gaming convention near you. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WZtAVSPnE3g

‘The Screamer’ is one of the deadliest enemies in the upcoming motorbike combat racer ‘Steel Rats’ and this new trailer reveals how the ingenious ‘Ride Again’ workshop in Poland brought this metal monstrosity to life as a playable demo station and junk infused work of art.
